title: Proof length after three-query conversion
statement: Let $n\ge 1$, let $P$ be a property of Boolean words of length $n$, and let a PCPP description for $P$ have proof length $L$, positive query count $r$, and a finite verifier seed set of size $S$. The proof length of the associated three-query PCPP description is $L+r2^rS$.
hypotheses_covered: A PCPP description for a property $P$ of Boolean words of length $n$.
The description's query count $r$ is positive.
The description includes its finite verifier and seed set.
